feedback:
43/48 correct with cli:codex:gpt-5.6-sol. Most common mistakes: expected cancel_order, got late_delivery (x2); expected payment, got praise (x2); expected refund, got wrong_item (x1)
Examples:
expected cancel_order, got late_delivery: 等了一个小时还没到，不要了，帮我取消
expected refund, got wrong_item: 奶茶太甜了，完全没按少糖做，喝不了，要求退款
expected cancel_order, got late_delivery: Delivery is taking forever, just cancel it and give me my money back
expected payment, got praise: 骑手特别好，想给他加点小费，在哪里加
expected payment, got praise: The rider was amazing, how do I add a tip after delivery?
